title: When the Drop Breaks
author: Gideon Hartwell
blurb: Sable Nystrom, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
